title: Customer Appreciation and Satisfaction
summary: Reviews in this topic center on customers expressing appreciation or satisfaction with design, driving feel, comfort, and purchase decisions, with a smaller set citing disappointment about limited electric mileage or a removed feature and many fragments too vague to classify confidently.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the vehicle’s design, driving feel, comfort, and owners’ satisfaction with their purchase decision.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe disappointment with limited electric-motor mileage and the removal of a previously available feature.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews often express appreciation, satisfaction, or desired changes in terms that are too vague or incomplete to assign a clear sentiment confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are brief or generic expressions of appreciation without enough context to classify sentiment reliably.
The topic includes both clear product feedback and vague appreciation-for-information comments, which limits how specifically the theme can be summarized.
The available examples are sentiment-stratified samples and are not representative estimates of the full review population.
